sloka: ततः प्रभात समये दिवसे अथ चतुर्दशे ।समेत्य राज कर्तारः भरतम् वाक्यम् अब्रुवन् ॥२-७९-१॥
transliteration: tataḥ prabhāta samaye divase atha caturdaśe ।sametya rāja kartāraḥ bharatam vākyam abruvan ॥2-79-1॥

translations.english: Then, at the hour of dawn on the fourteenth day, all those who were empowered to proclaim the king, assembled and addressed Bharata:
